dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each natural number n, this is the type of run records generated by D011. A run packages a floating-point format, a proof that n is positive, two real n by n arrays A and RHat, structural assumptions on those arrays, and witnesses for every required off-diagonal and diagonal computation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target is universally quantified only over inhabitants of this run type, so all data and assumptions packaged by D011 are implicit hypotheses of the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the third field of a run, namely its real matrix A indexed by Fin n × Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies every occurrence of A in the residual inequalities and in the identity RHatᵀRHat = A + ΔA.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the fourth field of a run, namely its real matrix RHat indexed by Fin n × Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the computed upper-triangular matrix used in all partial products, magnitude bounds, and the product RHatᵀRHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the first field of a run, its floating-point format object.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the run to the unit roundoff used in every displayed bound and to the format assumptions governing the packaged executions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 12 of a format, the real unit-roundoff parameter u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every right-hand side in the target is multiplied by this same u.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: For real matrices X and Y, this defines Q(X,Y)ᵢⱼ = Σₖ |Xᵢₖ||Yₖⱼ|, with k ranging over all Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With X = RHatᵀ and Y = RHat, it becomes Pᵢⱼ = Σₖ |RHatₖᵢ||RHatₖⱼ|, the componentwise magnitude factor in both bounds on ΔA.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For R and indices i,j, this is Mᵢⱼ = Σ_{k<i} |Rₖᵢ||Rₖⱼ| + |Rᵢᵢ||Rᵢⱼ|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the nonnegative magnitude factor in the off-diagonal and diagonal local residual bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For R and indices i,j, this is Cᵢⱼ = Σ_{k<i} RₖᵢRₖⱼ + RᵢᵢRᵢⱼ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The first two target conjuncts bound |Aᵢⱼ - Cᵢⱼ|, with i<j off the diagonal and i=j on the diagonal.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary real matrix multiplication: (XY)ᵢⱼ = Σₖ XᵢₖYₖⱼ over all k in Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to RHatᵀ and RHat, it forms the exact real matrix product in the backward-error identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: This transposes a matrix: Xᵀᵢⱼ = Xⱼᵢ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the product in the existential conclusion equal to RHatᵀRHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a run from a format F, 0<n, matrices A and RHat, representability of every entry of both matrices, symmetry Aᵢⱼ=Aⱼᵢ, upper triangularity RHatᵢⱼ=0 when j<i, an off-diagonal execution witness for every i<j, and a diagonal execution witness for every j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are all implicit hypotheses carried by the universally quantified run. In particular, the theorem is conditional on both the structural matrix assumptions and the existence of the computation witnesses.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of floating-point format records generated by D017.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the abstract representability predicate, safe-range predicate, rounding map, and unit roundoff underlying the run and its executions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: For R, this is Σ_{k<i} |Rₖᵢ||Rₖⱼ|. LocalDef019 embeds each k in Fin i into Fin n without changing its natural value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Adding |Rᵢᵢ||Rᵢⱼ| produces LocalDef007, the local residual magnitude factor.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: For R, this is Σ_{k<i} RₖᵢRₖⱼ, where the sum is over natural indices strictly below i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Adding RᵢᵢRᵢⱼ produces LocalDef008, the exact partial inner product compared with Aᵢⱼ.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of evidence that a diagonal entry j was produced by a diagonal execution compatible with a format F and matrices A,R. Its constructor is D020.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A run contains one such witness for every j; through D020 and D037 it imports the diagonal computation conditions and its local residual inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of evidence that an off-diagonal entry (i,j) was produced by an off-diagonal execution compatible with a format F and matrices A,R. Its constructor is D021.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A run contains such evidence for every i<j; through D021 and D036 it imports the off-diagonal computation conditions and residual inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: A format consists of naturals β,p, integer exponent limits e_min,e_max, predicates Rep and Safe on the reals, a rounding map rnd, and u∈ℝ. It assumes 2≤β, 0<p, e_min<e_max, a finite set of representable reals, u≥0, u·(2·β^(p-1))=1, Rep(0), Rep(1), Safe(x) implies Rep(rnd(x)), nearest-representable rounding on Safe inputs, and rnd(x)=x for every representable x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It guarantees nonnegative u and defines the abstract arithmetic model required by all packaged computation witnesses. The exponent limits have no further connection to Rep or Safe in the supplied declarations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 8 of a format, its representability predicate Rep : ℝ → Prop.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Representability assumptions on matrix entries, execution inputs, and reduction-tree leaves are expressed through this predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given i∈Fin n and k∈Fin(i.val), this embeds k into Fin n with the same natural value, using k<i<n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes every sum indexed by Fin(i.val) exactly a sum over the zero-based indices k with 0≤k<i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: This turns a diagonal execution of length j into diagonal evidence by requiring matching formats, execution vectors aₖ=bₖ=Rₖⱼ for k<j, scalar c=Aⱼⱼ, and output yHat=Rⱼⱼ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specializes the generic diagonal execution bound to |Aⱼⱼ-(Σ_{k<j}Rₖⱼ²+Rⱼⱼ²)| and its corresponding magnitude factor.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: This turns an off-diagonal execution of length i into evidence for (i,j) by requiring matching formats, aₖ=Rₖᵢ, bₖ=Rₖⱼ for k<i, pivot bK=Rᵢᵢ, scalar c=Aᵢⱼ, and output yHat=Rᵢⱼ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specializes the generic off-diagonal residual bound to the first conjunct of the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that if k∈Fin n and s∈Fin(k.val), then s.val<n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It justifies the index embedding LocalDef019 and therefore the interpretation of its finite sums; it adds no numerical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each m, this is the type of off-diagonal execution records generated by D036.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Such a record carries the rounded-product, rounded-reduction, optional division, safe-range, representability, and residual-bound data used for each i<j.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the first input vector a from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 identifies it with the first i entries of column i of RHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the second input vector b from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 identifies it with the first i entries of column j of RHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the pivot or divisor bK from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 identifies it with RHatᵢᵢ; the execution therefore requires RHatᵢᵢ≠0 whenever an i<j execution is required.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the scalar c from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 identifies it with Aᵢⱼ.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the format from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 requires it to equal the run's format, ensuring that all its rounding and error data use the target's unit roundoff.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the computed output yHat from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 identifies it with RHatᵢⱼ.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each m, this is the type of diagonal square-root execution records generated by D037.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Such a record carries the rounded-product and reduction computation, nonnegative square-root step, safe-range conditions, and diagonal residual inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the first input vector a from a diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D020 identifies it with the entries RHatₖⱼ for k<j.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the second input vector b from a diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D020 also identifies it with RHatₖⱼ for k<j, turning products aₖbₖ into squares.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the scalar c from a diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D020 identifies it with Aⱼⱼ.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the format from a diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D020 requires it to equal the run's format.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the computed output yHat from a diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D020 identifies it with RHatⱼⱼ.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: An off-diagonal execution of length m contains F,a,b,bK,c with all aₖ,bₖ,bK,c representable, bK≠0, and Safe(aₖbₖ). It chooses a binary reduction tree with m+1 leaves and a permutation, validates a term vector consisting of c and the values -rnd(aₖbₖ), and sets a numerator N to the tree's rounded reduction. Its output y satisfies y=N if bK=1, while if bK≠1 then Safe(N/bK) and y=rnd(N/bK). It explicitly carries |(c-Σₖaₖbₖ)-bK·y|≤(m+1)u(|bK·y|+Σₖ|aₖbₖ|), and when bK=1 it also carries the tighter bound |(c-Σₖaₖbₖ)-y|≤m u(|y|+Σₖ|aₖbₖ|).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: After D021 substitutes m=i, aₖ=RHatₖᵢ, bₖ=RHatₖⱼ, bK=RHatᵢᵢ, c=Aᵢⱼ, and y=RHatᵢⱼ, its first stored error inequality is exactly the source of the target's off-diagonal bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: A diagonal execution of length m contains F,a,b,c with all aₖ,bₖ,c representable and Safe(aₖbₖ). It chooses a binary tree with m+1 leaves and a permutation, validates and reduces the terms c and -rnd(aₖbₖ), and calls the rounded reduction N. It assumes N≥0, Safe(sqrt(N)), y=rnd(sqrt(N)), y≥0, and explicitly carries |(c-Σₖaₖbₖ)-y²|≤(m+2)u(|y²|+Σₖ|aₖbₖ|).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: After D020 substitutes aₖ=bₖ=RHatₖⱼ, c=Aⱼⱼ, and y=RHatⱼⱼ, the stored error inequality gives the target's diagonal bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 11 of a format, its rounding function rnd : ℝ → ℝ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines all rounded products, rounded tree additions, divisions, and square roots in the packaged executions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 10 of a format, its abstract safe-range predicate Safe : ℝ → Prop.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Execution records require this predicate before the relevant rounding operations; it is otherwise unconstrained by the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is an inductive family of full binary reduction-tree shapes indexed by their positive number of leaves: a leaf has one leaf and a node combines trees with m and n leaves into one with m+n leaves.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every packaged execution may choose such a tree to specify the association order of its rounded summation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: For vectors a,b of length m and scalar c, this produces a vector of length m+1 whose entry 0 is c and whose entry k+1 is -rnd(aₖbₖ).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: After permutation, these are the leaves reduced to form the execution numerator c minus rounded products.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: This evaluates a leaf-labelled reduction tree: a leaf returns its supplied value, and each internal node returns rnd(left_result+right_result).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the computed numerator used by both execution types; these rounded intermediate values do not occur directly in the final displayed inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: This recursively validates a tree evaluation. Every leaf value must be representable; both subtrees must be valid; and at each internal node the exact sum of the two computed child results must satisfy Safe before it is rounded.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts admissible executions to rounded reductions whose leaves are representable and whose additions remain in the abstract safe range.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a tree and a motive, this recursively stores unit data at a leaf and, at a node, pairs each child's motive value with that child's corresponding recursive auxiliary data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is proof-level paramorphism infrastructure used to implement D042 and D043; it adds no independent mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a paramorphic fold over a reduction tree: the supplied function receives each subtree together with the recursively accumulated D044 data and returns the motive value at that subtree.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the recursive evaluations and validity predicates for reduction trees without changing their mathematical meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the one-leaf reduction tree.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the base case for the rounded reduction and validity definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: This combines an m-leaf tree and an n-leaf tree into an (m+n)-leaf binary node.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents an internal rounded addition and determines how a summation is associated.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: This computes the rounded product rnd(aᵢbᵢ).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its negation supplies each noninitial leaf of the execution's numerator reduction.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the proof of the natural-number fact 0<1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constructs the unique index of a one-element leaf vector and has no substantive numerical effect.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: This performs dependent case analysis on a leaf-labelled reduction tree, applying a leaf branch or a node branch while preserving the indexed vector type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is implementation machinery inside the tree folds D042 and D043 and contributes no extra assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: This recursively computes both a motive value for a tree and the D044 auxiliary structure containing the corresponding results for its subtrees.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the paramorphism D045 used by the execution definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a dependent eliminator that distinguishes a one-leaf tree from a binary node, discarding recursive hypotheses.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports D050's shape analysis and has no independent mathematical effect.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the ordinary dependent recursor for binary reduction trees, with a leaf case and a node case receiving both recursive results.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is foundational recursion machinery for the tree computations and validation predicates.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires the off-diagonal bounds, diagonal bounds, backward-error identity, and both ΔA bounds to hold simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses all execution-field identifications and the exact function equality RHatᵀRHat=A+ΔA.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It asserts the existence of a real n by n perturbation matrix ΔA satisfying the identity and both componentwise bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the type of natural indices k satisfying k<n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrices are finite n by n arrays with zero-based row and column indices.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the underlying natural value of a bounded index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines order comparisons, summation limits, and coefficients such as i+1 and i+2.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is typeclass-dispatched addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: In this dossier it realizes natural addition, real addition, and pointwise matrix addition according to the displayed types.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is typeclass-dispatched multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At all target-relevant occurrences it is ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is typeclass-dispatched subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At target-relevant occurrences it is ordinary real subtraction in residuals; in the format normalization it also supplies natural p-1 through the appropriate natural instance.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is typeclass-dispatched non-strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is ordinary ≤ on the reals in all error bounds and format inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is typeclass-dispatched strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is ordinary natural-number < for index ordering and positivity conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the dimension n, zero-based indices, radix and precision, and all integer-valued error coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This maps a natural number into a type carrying a natural-number cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets i+1, i+2, n+1, m, and related coefficients as real numbers before multiplication by u.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets a numeral in a type through its OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the constants 0, 1, and 2 with the natural or real type required at each occurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips function spaces with pointwise addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes A+ΔA mean the matrix whose (i,j) entry is Aᵢⱼ+ΔAᵢⱼ.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, computed quantities, unit roundoff, absolute values, and inequalities are over exact real arithmetic.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary addition on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It realizes scalar additions in matrix products, residual formulas, magnitude factors, and pointwise matrix addition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the additive-group structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports real subtraction, negation, and the absolute-value operation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard non-strict order on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All displayed target inequalities use this ordinary real order.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary multiplication on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It realizes matrix products and every scalar factor in the error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the canonical embedding of natural numbers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the usual real meanings to the natural coefficients in the bounds and to the radix in the unit-roundoff equation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines real subtraction as addition of the negative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the standard residual differences Aᵢⱼ-Cᵢⱼ and the differences appearing in execution bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the lattice order structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the additive group it makes abs the standard real absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: In an ordered additive group this is max(x,-x); on ℝ it is the ordinary absolute value |x|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every error measure and every componentwise magnitude product in the proposition uses scalar absolute value, not a matrix norm.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms i+1, i+2, n+1, m+1, m+2, and combined tree sizes.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts a homogeneous Add instance into homogeneous HAdd notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It dispatches the additions to the ordinary natural, real, or pointwise function additions already described.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts a homogeneous Mul instance into homogeneous HMul notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It dispatches target products to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts a homogeneous Sub instance into homogeneous HSub notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It dispatches residual subtraction to real subtraction and precision subtraction to natural subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives i

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets each natural numeral as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural constants used in index shifts and coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: This gives Fin n its finite enumeration of all indices 0 through n-1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the domains of every finite sum over matrix indices.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: On real-valued functions over Fin n or Fin i, it is ordinary finite real summation, with an empty sum equal to zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each sum range over all indices in the relevant Fin type.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the additive commutative-monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives finite real sums their usual associative, commutative addition and zero empty sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the real number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used for empty sums and for the asserted zero entries below the diagonal of RHat.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets the numeral 0 using a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real zero and related typed zero constants without adding a hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.mk
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a bounded natural index from a value and a proof that it is below the bound.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the embedding of indices k<i into the ambient dimension n.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is typeclass-dispatched exponentiation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives β^(p-1) in the format normalization and y² in diagonal executions their usual natural-power meanings over the reals.

dependency_coverage.name: Int
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of integers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used only for the format's minimum and maximum exponent parameters.

dependency_coverage.name: Int.instLTInt
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary strict order on integers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the format condition e_min<e_max an ordinary integer inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies natural-number powers in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For ℝ it gives the ordinary powers β^(p-1) and y².

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that n+1 is at least two when n is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies typeclass evidence needed to interpret certain natural numerals or casts in indexed constructions; it adds no new target assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that n+1 is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the at-least-two and numeral infrastructure used by successor-sized finite types.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets the numeral 1 using a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real or natural one in unit-roundoff and execution conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the multiplicative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports real natural powers and products.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the real number one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the unit-roundoff normalization and in the bK=1 special case of off-diagonal executions.

dependency_coverage.name: Set.Finite
dependency_coverage.meaning: This asserts that a set has finitely many elements.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The format constructor requires the set of representable real numbers to be finite.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts a Pow instance into homogeneous HPow notation.

binders: An arbitrary natural number n is implicitly quantified.
An arbitrary run r of dimension n is quantified; write A for its third field, R for its fourth field RHat, F for its format, and u for F's unit roundoff.
The off-diagonal assertion quantifies over all i,j∈{0,…,n-1} and assumes i<j.
The diagonal assertion quantifies over every j∈{0,…,n-1}.
The backward-error assertion existentially quantifies a real n by n matrix ΔA; the same witness must satisfy the exact identity and both families of componentwise bounds.
hypotheses: Its format F has natural radix β and precision p, integer bounds e_min<e_max, a finite representable set Rep, a safe-range predicate Safe, a rounding function rnd, and u≥0, with 2≤β, p>0, u·(2·β^(p-1))=1, Rep(0), and Rep(1).
For every Safe real x, rnd(x) is representable and minimizes |x-z| among all representable z; every representable x is fixed exactly by rnd.
Every entry of A and R is representable.
A is symmetric: Aᵢⱼ=Aⱼᵢ for all i,j.
R is upper triangular: Rᵢⱼ=0 whenever j<i.

For each i<j, the run carries an off-diagonal execution of length i with aₖ=Rₖᵢ and bₖ=Rₖⱼ for k<i, pivot bK=Rᵢᵢ, c=Aᵢⱼ, and output y=Rᵢⱼ. Such an execution includes representability of a,b,bK,c, bK≠0, Safe(aₖbₖ), a permitted rounded binary-tree reduction of the permuted terms c and -rnd(aₖbₖ), the specified division behavior, and both residual inequalities stated in D036.

For each j, the run carries a diagonal execution of length j with aₖ=bₖ=Rₖⱼ for k<j, c=Aⱼⱼ, and output y=Rⱼⱼ. Such an execution includes representability and product-safe-range assumptions, a permitted rounded binary-tree reduction of c and -rnd(aₖbₖ), a nonnegative numerator N, Safe(sqrt(N)), y=rnd(sqrt(N))≥0, and the residual inequality stated in D037.
conclusions: There exists a real n by n matrix ΔA such that RᵀR=A+ΔA exactly, entry by entry.
For that same ΔA and all i,j, |ΔAᵢⱼ| ≤ (i+2)u Σ_{k=0}^{n-1}|Rₖᵢ||Rₖⱼ|.
For that same ΔA and all i,j, |ΔAᵢⱼ| ≤ (n+1)u Σ_{k=0}^{n-1}|Rₖᵢ||Rₖⱼ|.
mathematical_definitions: Indices are zero-based: Fin n is identified with I_n={0,…,n-1}; a sum over k<i means k=0,…,i-1, and is zero when i=0.
A rounded reduction tree returns its leaf value at a one-leaf tree and returns rnd(x+y) at every internal node whose child results are x and y.
A valid rounded reduction requires every leaf to be representable and, recursively, every exact child-result sum at an internal node to satisfy Safe before rounding.
The execution numerator is the valid rounded-tree reduction, in an arbitrary permutation and association order, of the m+1 values c,-rnd(a₀b₀),…,-rnd(a_{m-1}b_{m-1}).
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every positive-dimensional run satisfying the packaged abstract floating-point format, representability, symmetry, upper-triangularity, and detailed off-diagonal and diagonal execution conditions, each strict-upper-triangular entry has the stated (i+1)u componentwise residual bound and each diagonal entry has the stated (j+2)u bound. Moreover, one can choose a single perturbation matrix ΔA for which the exact real identity RᵀR=A+ΔA holds and whose entries satisfy both the row-dependent (i+2)u bound and the uniform (n+1)u bound, each scaled by Σₖ|Rₖᵢ||Rₖⱼ|.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Although n is quantified over all naturals, no run can be constructed when n=0 because a run contains 0<n. The theorem is therefore vacuous at n=0.

More generally, the proposition is conditional on the existence of a highly structured run. If the required format or any required execution witness does not exist, the universal statement has no instance to which it applies.

The off-diagonal and diagonal execution constructors already contain the corresponding local residual inequalities as fields. Thus the first two target conclusions rely on error inequalities packaged as execution assumptions, not solely on the abstract rounding axioms.

Every off-diagonal execution requires its pivot Rᵢᵢ to be nonzero. Consequently, whenever there exists j>i, admissible runs must have Rᵢᵢ≠0; no analogous nonzero requirement is imposed on the final diagonal entry.
The format is abstract. Rep and Safe are arbitrary predicates subject only to the listed axioms, and the integer exponent limits are not connected to either predicate by any supplied condition.
Safe-range assumptions are local to the products, tree additions, division, and square-root operations explicitly recorded in the executions; there is no global no-overflow or no-underflow assertion.
The proposition uses scalar absolute values and entrywise inequalities. It contains no vector norm, matrix norm, condition-number bound, or aggregate backward-error bound.
The first residual family covers only i<j. No separate local residual inequality is stated for lower-triangular positions i>j.

The perturbation ΔA is not explicitly required to be representable, triangular, or symmetric. Symmetry follows mathematically from RᵀR=A+ΔA together with symmetry of A, but is not a separate target conjunct.
No smallness condition such as (n+1)u<1 is assumed.

Both ΔA bounds are explicitly asserted for the same witness. Since i≤n-1 and their remaining factors are nonnegative, the (n+1)u bound is mathematically weaker than the (i+2)u bound, but it remains a distinct conjunct.
The matrix product RᵀR and all quantities in the conclusions are exact real expressions formed from the stored entries; the rounded operations occur only inside the packaged execution model.
No positive-definiteness assumption on A, global nonsingularity assumption on R, or independent specification of a concrete matrix-factorization algorithm is encoded.
